mechanics.claim: On fatal damage Sion enters stasis then reanimates to full health rather than instantly.
mechanics.quote: '''Sion''' enters {{tip|stasis}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds to {{tip|Zombie state|reanimate}} into a frenzy, restoring {{as|100% of his '''maximum''' health}}

mechanics.claim: During zombie state, health regeneration and incoming healing (except life steal and omnivamp) are 0% effective.
mechanics.quote: any {{tip|heal|healing}} (except {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|omnivamp}}) he receives during this time is {{tt|0% effective|See notes}}

mechanics.claim: Sion's health decays in ticks every 0.25s during zombie state, with tick loss increasing each subsequent tick.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|health resource|losing}} {{as|{{pp|2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1) for 20}} health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}, increasing by{{ft|70% of the '''base''' value

mechanics.claim: During zombie state Sion can only move, basic attack, and use item actives, plus one cast of Death Surge which replaces all his abilities.
mechanics.quote: '''Sion''' can only move and use his {{tip|basic attacks}} and [[active ability items|item actives]]... One cast of ''{{ai|Death Surge|Sion}}'', which replaces all of his {{tip|abilities}}

mechanics.claim: The on-hit bonus physical damage from Glory in Death is not amplified by life steal.
mechanics.quote: The bonus on-hit damage granted by ''Glory in Death'' is unaffected by {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}

mechanics.claim: The fixed 1.75 attack speed is not affected by other attack speed modifiers such as bonus attack speed.
mechanics.quote: This also means that it's unaffected by other attack speed modifiers for the duration, such as bonus attack speed or {{tip|cripple|cripples}}

mechanics.claim: The full-health heal on entering zombie state cannot be reduced by Grievous Wounds and doesn't count as healing done.
mechanics.quote: The effect that heals '''Sion''' back to full health at the start of ''Glory in Death'' cannot be modified by {{tip|Grievous Wounds|healing reduction}}

mechanics.claim: Death Surge cooldown resets upon death.
